scope: Repair two pre-existing MATERIAL test failures without expanding production support
baseline: Both controls failed against source preceding the AC1021 sparse MATERIAL reader change.
normal_boundaries: The direct dxfRW codec control inherited dx_iface's whole-document finalizer despite not preparing its graph. Its fixture now finalizes using the direct write result; adapter fileExport controls still use the real graph finalizer. All 64 profiles, 542 readbacks, 24 callback-mutation refusals and 46 retries pass.
sparse_raw: Keep modern AC1027 sparse-material refusal and destination rollback. A manually authored material lacks the exact modern retained-source body required for replay; test same-writer invalid/corrected retry at legacy AC1018, whose manual codec is already supported. Both ASCII and binary input iterations pass.
validation: Focused CTest: material_normal_boundaries, sparse_material_control_groups, dwg_material_replay_refusal and dxf_sparse_material_raw: 4/4 PASS.
limitations: This is test maintenance, not new MATERIAL format or consumer qualification. The AC1027 exact-source replay guard remains unchanged.
